Who we are

Not a chat group. An ecosystem with a weekly operating rhythm, a company behind it, and a platform that turns learning into work.

Botmartz Community is an AI-focused developer and student ecosystem built to help learners move past theory and build real AI systems. It is run by Botmartz AI Solutions Pvt. Ltd., an AI engineering company that designs and deploys production RAG, AI agents and LLM applications for businesses. The same engineers who ship client systems run the sessions.

We bring together students, developers, AI builders, colleges, developer communities and companies through technical education, hands-on workshops, hackathons, build challenges, project showcases, AMAs, career support and strategic partnerships.

Everything we run maps to four pillars.

Learn

  • AI engineering sessions
  • RAG, LangChain, LangGraph
  • Agentic AI
  • Technical workshops
  • 30-day challenges

From learning to work

The community feeds a platform. The platform feeds companies. That is the loop partners join.

Live

community.botmartz.com

A 45-day, project-based virtual AI internship and engineering playground. Members pick from 50 production-style systems across generative AI, RAG, agents and applied domains, ship daily proof of work on GitHub, and are benchmarked against defined standards.

  • Guided projects based on real-world scenarios
  • Member profiles and resumes hosted on the platform
  • Profile matching to relevant roles and internships
  • Referrals to partner companies for members who complete tracks

community.botmartz.com

Setting up

Botmartz Labs

In-college labs that give students on each campus structured guidance to work on company problems and deliver usable results. Labs run alongside the college MoU program.

  • Campus-based cohort with a Botmartz mentor
  • Company problem statements as lab projects
  • Direct path from lab to internship or hiring

Track record

What we have run and what is scheduled. Each entry is a reference a partner can check.

2026Indore, one day

AI Frontier 2026: The future of AI engineering

Botmartz flagship event. AI engineers, developers, founders, researchers and students.

Expert talks, live demos and hands-on learning on foundation models, autonomous agents, RAG, evaluation, deployment and responsible AI. The day closed with the launch of the Botmartz AI Engineering Community and an official event magazine.

  • Keynote: Dr. Promit Ray, "Where is AI heading? Intelligence as infrastructure"
  • Session: Soham Sharma, Retrieval-Augmented Generation fundamentals
  • Hands-on: Harsh Sahu, building AI agents on GTWY.ai
  • Output: participants built and ran their own agents on the day
6 Sep 2026Walkover, Indore

Build with AI: Code for Communities 2.0, Indore Edition

Organised by GDG Indore in collaboration with Botmartz AI Solutions. One-day offline hackathon.

Botmartz was the collaborating and sponsoring partner. Participants built AI solutions for community problems and received co-branded GDG Indore and Botmartz certificates.

  • Sponsorship and AI engineering roadmap
  • RAG resources and architecture reviews
  • Community access for all participants
  • Certificates and internship opportunities
25 to 26 Apr 2026Sage University, Indore

Udbhav'26, 24-hour student hackathon

National student hackathon with AI and LLM, sustainability, web and cybersecurity tracks.

Botmartz served on the judging panel.

AI engineering workshop: agentic AI, LangChain and RAG

Hands-on, instructor-led session with live Q and A. Registration through community.botmartz.com.

Digital sponsorship inventory

Placements that work without a physical event. Each one can be bought alone or bundled into a tier.

Placement What you get Format
Presented-by challenge Title sponsorship of a 30-day build challenge. Your tool or problem statement as the challenge track, your name on every daily post and on completion certificates. 30 days, WhatsApp, Discord, platform
Webinar or AMA title sponsor A session on your topic with your speaker. We handle promotion, registrations, moderation, follow-up and recording. 60 to 90 minutes, online
Community announcement A sponsor message distributed across the WhatsApp community and Discord, written with us so it lands as content, not an ad. Per announcement
Sponsored Discord channel A dedicated channel for your product, tool or hiring, moderated by us, with an intro session to kick it off. Monthly or quarterly
Social feature Co-branded posts on the Botmartz LinkedIn page and community handles: event recaps, member spotlights, tool walkthroughs. Per post or series
Magazine placement Ad page or sponsored feature in the official event magazine (AI Frontier edition), distributed digitally to attendees and the community. Per edition
Certificate co-branding Your logo on participation and completion certificates for a program or event. Per program
Platform placement Your problem statement as a guided project on community.botmartz.com, or a hiring-partner listing with referral access. Per track or listing
Talent access Curated shortlists from the platform, resume-review cohorts and hackathon teams, with introductions handled by us. Per hiring round
Post-program report Reach, registrations, attendance, engagement and outcomes for every sponsored placement. Included with every placement

Every placement includes a post-program report. We do not sell unverified reach numbers.
